formulas.availableCapacity: min(pressureCapacity, operatingCeiling)*availability + explicitly assumed available expansion
formulas.monthlyVolume: calendar-day average rate * actual calendar days
formulas.variance: synthetic actual volume - frozen forecast volume

provenance.producedWater: synthetic seeded histories; future actuals excluded from training
provenance.injectors: fictional assumed constant-J educational scenarios; no real-well calibration
provenance.pvt: Owner-authorized Nexus brine/PVT modules and carried pyResToolbox reference fixtures; no live MCP call claimed
provenance.publicHistory: public reported monthly liquid injection; calendar-day average calculated

assumptions: Forecast frozen at 2025-12; new-well schedule edits do not change actuals or fitted forecast.
Injectivity is fixed with pressure and time; no fracture, transient, layered or calibrated well model.
Assumed pressure limit is bottomhole psia, not a copied surface permit maximum.
Additional expansion is available stock-tank capacity after downtime; no implicit availability multiplier.
Nexus brine density uses temperature/salinity and ignores pressure; FVF/salinity and viscosity use simplified correlations and source clamps.
Public reported liquid injection is not assigned to synthetic producers or fictional injectors.
